image_description: A side-profile view of a large American bison standing on a gravel path. The animal features a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump and a beard. The hindquarters are less furred and smoother. Short curved horns are visible, and the tail ends in a bushy tuft. Other bison are visible in the blurred background.
